stem:
Workers at a school are covering a rectangular patio with square tiles. Each square tile has an area of 1 square yard. The figure shows the part of the patio that has already been covered with square tiles.

[Image shows a rectangular shape with visible tile markings on left and bottom edges, each square represents 1 square yard.]
instruction: What is the area of the entire patio in square yards?
visual_elements: Rectangle with part tiled along left vertical and bottom horizontal edges, each square tile area = 1 square yard
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding area calculation and counting tiles to determine full area of rectangular patio, involving modest reasoning with spatial visualization.
